name: get_block
description: A block's files in full, the packages they need, and the command that adds it to a project.

name.description: A block's name from list_blocks, such as sign-in.

version.description: The @nuvui/react version in the project's package.json, such as 0.6.2 or ^0.6.0, for the docs of that release. Leave it out for the latest release.

name: get_changes
description: What each @nuvui/* package added and changed after the versions a project has, from the packages' changelogs, newest first, and what's in the docs but in no release yet. Pass the @nuvui/* entries of the project's package.json. Without them: the latest version of each package.

installed.description: The @nuvui/* packages in the project's package.json, with their versions as written there, such as { "@nuvui/react": "^0.6.0", "@nuvui/table": "0.1.6" }.

name: get_chart
description: A chart's file in full, such as bar/stacked, from list_charts.

name.description: A chart's id from list_charts, such as bar/stacked.

name: get_page
description: One page of the reference, as Markdown: a component's parts, props, examples, CSS variables, classes and accessibility, or a guide. Takes a page's id from list_components, list_guides or search_docs, or a component's name, such as Compare or DataTable. A section gives only that part of the page, such as Props or CSS variables.

page.description: A page's id, such as components/compare, or a component's name.

section.description: A `##` heading on the page, such as Props, Accessibility or CSS variables.

version.description: The @nuvui/react version in the project's package.json, such as 0.6.2 or ^0.6.0, for the docs of that release. Leave it out for the latest release.

annotations.title: Read a page of the docs

name: get_rules
description: Start here. Without a topic: the versions these docs describe, what to know before writing code with nuvui, the packages, the rules in a line each, and which component meets which need. With a topic: that rule in full, with wrong and right code.

topic.description: One of: accessibility, composition, forms, packages, server-components, styling, text-and-direction.

version.description: The @nuvui/react version in the project's package.json, such as 0.6.2 or ^0.6.0, for the docs of that release. Leave it out for the latest release.

name: get_tokens
description: The design tokens as CSS custom properties, for your own CSS: var(--color-primary), never a color written out. A prefix gives only those, such as --color-, --radius- or --text-.

version.description: The @nuvui/react version in the project's package.json, such as 0.6.2 or ^0.6.0, for the docs of that release. Leave it out for the latest release.

name: list_blocks
description: Blocks are screens and parts of apps built from the components, such as a sign-in screen, a dashboard or a pricing table, each a TSX file and an SCSS file to copy and change. Look here before building a screen from nothing.

category.description: One of: accounts, chat, dashboard, data, editor, flows, layout, marketing, media, settings.

version.description: The @nuvui/react version in the project's package.json, such as 0.6.2 or ^0.6.0, for the docs of that release. Leave it out for the latest release.

name: list_charts
description: Charts built with @nuvui/charts on Recharts, each one file to copy: area, bar, line, pie, radar, radial, scatter and more.

family.description: One of: area, bar, line, pie, radar, radial, tooltip, composed, scatter, dashboard.

name: list_components
description: Every component page, by package, with what each is for in a line. Pass a package to see only its pages.

package.description: A package, such as @nuvui/table or table. One of: @nuvui/react, @nuvui/date-picker, @nuvui/table, @nuvui/charts, @nuvui/barcodes, @nuvui/chat, @nuvui/kanban, @nuvui/editor, @nuvui/emoji, @nuvui/map, @nuvui/flow, @nuvui/media, @nuvui/backgrounds, @nuvui/icons.

version.description: The @nuvui/react version in the project's package.json, such as 0.6.2 or ^0.6.0, for the docs of that release. Leave it out for the latest release.

name: list_guides
description: The pages that aren't about one component: getting started, theming, Tailwind, SCSS, forms, right to left, translation, the Content Security Policy, support, and recipes for whole screens.

version.description: The @nuvui/react version in the project's package.json, such as 0.6.2 or ^0.6.0, for the docs of that release. Leave it out for the latest release.

name: search_docs
description: Finds the sections of the reference that best answer a question or a few words, such as 'sortable table', 'dark mode' or 'error message on a field'. Each result names its page and section, for get_page.

version.description: The @nuvui/react version in the project's package.json, such as 0.6.2 or ^0.6.0, for the docs of that release. Leave it out for the latest release.
